Focused assessment of Ultra's1520 substantive interim, under Harjas's return-driven policy. I read the exact released prompt, the complete preserved public parent messages/relevant successful and failed tool outputs, and the partial receive.py, kernel.py, compress.py, verify_closed.py, allocation_bounds.py and saved examples. This is source-based judgment, not an independent replay or a completed review of the not-yet-delivered all-allocation proof.

The important advance is the continuous acoustic completion: the ordinary pseudoinverse value at a singular ray loses a positive limiting term. The exact receiver reconstructs two binary-cubic jet charges whose combined map has rank8 and precisely the translation kernel. This links the correction to the whole nontranslation quotient, beyond adding another tested wave pattern. The recorded exact receiver run passed. Closed acoustic atoms are limiting ROC inequalities, not finite-background Hessian evaluations.

Keep three claims separate: (1) the supplied-catalogue compressor has an algebraic <=17-atom guarantee; (2) the producer's <=16 bound concerns an OPTIMAL completed allocation for an actual field with positive-definite covariance, via a further global dual-contact argument; (3) neither says every field is certifiable or gives efficient discovery/bit complexity. The provided closed-field demo has covariance rank3, so it is not an executed validation of the positive-definite16-direction optimum. Its certificate is universal over admitted polynomials for that specified field, not over all gradients. The larger example's serialization failure and interrupted exact solve demonstrate computational costs; retaining the saved multiplier is a sensible exact-verification repair, with its successful completed outcome still to be distinguished from the preserved failed attempts.

Decision: PRESERVE the same active warm solo Ultra turn. No new Ultra message, fresh Pro replacement, local team, extra worker or interruption. The current work is moving the central representation/duality obstruction and responding substantively to its prompt; discovering a barrier while repairing it is productive depth. A failed chosen catalogue still is not an all-allocation or QC failure.
